mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within the last three months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the last three months signals increased demand for housing, which boosts related industries and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the last two months signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to increased prices and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on mechanism where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1%) signals accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 70% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven mechanism where a combination of rising employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 0.5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven mechanism where a combination of increasing retail sales (RSAFS) and decreasing unemployment (UNRATE) signals robust consumer demand and a strong labor market, which boosts corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 2 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional mechanism where a decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% during a recession signals a contraction in economic activity, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during a recessionary regime.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances during a recession.
